Text:
A surprising link between saving cattle and protecting Zimbabwe's majestic lions. 🇿🇼

It sounds counterintuitive, but new approaches to livestock management are having a profound impact on wildlife conservation. For years, human-wildlife conflict, particularly involving lions preying on cattle, has been a major challenge for rural communities and a threat to lion populations. 

Now, innovative strategies are helping farmers protect their herds, which in turn reduces retaliatory killings of lions. This shift is fostering a more sustainable coexistence, ensuring both livelihoods and the future of our incredible big cats.
